name: Cherokee Nation
description: An orange field bordered with a green-and-black rope pattern, charged with the seal of the Cherokee Nation surrounded by seven yellow seven-pointed stars, with a single black seven-pointed star in the upper fly.
history: The flag of the Cherokee Nation of Oklahoma, adopted in 1978. The seven-pointed stars stand for the seven Cherokee clans; the black star, added in 1989, mourns those who died on the Trail of Tears.

features.symbolism: in memory of those who died on the Trail of Tears
